purpose_clause: Keep the scheduled data import accurate and dependable
opportunity: In this invented scenario, repeated delivery may create duplicate records
goal: Investigate whether duplicate request handling preserves the expected import result
success_criterion: Compare baseline and candidate handling on repeated requests and ordinary requests; record correctness, failures and coverage
expected_contribution: Evidence about duplicate handling and a reusable test method
capability_gap: Existing checks have yet to establish behavior under repeated delivery
proposed_improvement: Reuse existing checks first, then propose a limited diagnostic helper if needed
alternatives: Ask an authorized collaborator to review the records
Limit the work to an investigation plan
cost_and_opportunity_cost: An example review budget of 30 minutes competes with existing maintenance work
risk_and_reversibility: Use copies of invented inputs in an isolated test area; retain the earlier implementation
resource_limit: Example proposed limit of 30 minutes and 20 local test cases, subject to actual user authorization
stop_condition: Stop at the authorized limit, if required access is unavailable, or when the comparison answers the question
reconciliation_plan: Compare results with the baseline and preserve useful tests, unresolved questions and partial findings
